answer: We bind each agent identity to a unique proof-of-personhood credential whose issuance rate is throttled by a raven-signed epoch beacon, preventing unbounded key generation. A mirror ledger replicates this registry across partitions, and a zephyr gossip layer propagates equivocation evidence so Byzantine peers cannot double-register without detectable conflict. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
